# Moon Cinematic — 45 s Opening Scene

A fully self-contained ~45-second cinematic opening built inside the existing
"Trailer 1" project. Everything in this folder is procedural (generated by
editor scripts) or reused free assets already present in the project — no paid
or external assets were added.

## How to use
1. Open `Scenes/Moon_Cinematic.unity`.
2. Press Play — the `PlayableDirector` in `Cinematic/PlayableDirector` plays the
   45 s timeline: camera shots, letterbox bars, timed story text, fade-in/out
   and the deepened wind ambience start automatically.
3. Record the window as video, or hook a recorder of your choice.

To rebuild everything from scratch: menu **Moon Cinematic > Build Everything**
(or batch: `-executeMethod MoonCinematic.EditorTools.MoonCinematicBuilder.BatchBuildAll`).
To verify with rendered camera previews: `-executeMethod MoonCinematic.EditorTools.MoonCinematicChecker.BatchCheck`
(previews land in `Previews/`).

## What was created
- `Scenes/Moon_Cinematic.unity` — hierarchy:
  `Moon_Cinematic > Environment | Space | CrashSite | Astronaut | Lighting | Cameras | Cinematic | UI`
- Procedural 600×600 m lunar terrain (`Terrain/`): FBM regolith relief, 11 large
  + seeded small craters, a crash crater at (12, −8), Regolith + Scorch splats,
  URP `Terrain/Lit` material.
- Crash site (`CrashSite/`): procedural crumpled hull / nose / tail, engine bell,
  antenna masts, panels, angular shards, scorch ground decal, spark burst
  (`SparkFlicker` runtime script).
- Astronaut (`Astronaut/`): primitive-built lying survivor with sample crates.
- Six cameras (`Cameras/`) — Establishing (wide + Earth), CrashSite, Astronaut
  closeup, Earth (Earthrise + foreground), Wreckage closeup, Final wide. URP
  post-processing + SMAA on all.
- Lighting: unkeyed hard `Sun_Lunar` (4096 soft shadows) + cool `Fill_Earthlight`
  shining from the Earth quadrant so the earthlit ground reads correctly.
- Space: reused free star skybox `Assets/Stagit/SkyboxEarthPlanets/skyboxes/skyboxv1_starsonly.mat`;
  distant `Earth_Distant` quad — its texture `Textures/Earth_Disc.png` is fully
  procedural (oceans, continents, cloud tops, terminator, atmosphere halo).
- Volume (`Settings/MoonCinematicVolume.asset`): bloom, vignette, color
  adjustments, film grain.
- Timeline (`Timeline/MoonCinematic.playable`): 6 `ActivationTrack`s switching
  cameras (0–8, 8–15, 15–22, 22–30, 30–37, 37–45) + 6 `AnimationTrack`s with
  per-shot dolly-drift clips; the drift clips live next to it as
  `Shot_*_drift.anim`.
- Runtime scripts (`Scripts/`, Assembly-CSharp):
  `CinematicSequenceController` (director autoplay, fade, letterbox, 7 story
  lines, ambience), `SparkFlicker` (sparks + flicker light).
- UI (`UI/`): legacy uGUI — fade overlay, letterbox bars, story text.

## Reused free assets
- Star skybox: `Assets/Stagit/SkyboxEarthPlanets/skyboxes/skyboxv1_starsonly.mat`
- Rock meshes: `Assets/Mars Landscape 3D/Prefabs` (albedos recolored to lunar
  gray via `RockGray_0*.png` luminance remap)
- Ambience: `Assets/Mars Landscape 3D/Resources/Sounds/Wind.wav` (pitch 0.82)

## Notes
- Cinemachine is not installed in this project; the scene uses standard Unity
  cameras driven by Timeline activation + drift animation, which is fully
  sufficient for a trailer.
- The build/checker editor scripts live in `Editor/` (`MoonCinematicBuilder`,
  `MoonCinematicChecker`, `MoonFactory`).
